brand.name: WebCrown
nav.label: Main navigation
hero.eyebrow: A more vivid way to meet your business
hero.title: Let customers step inside.
hero.tagline: Your business, beautifully brought to life.
hero.description: WebCrown creates immersive, easy-to-use websites for independent hotels, restaurants, shops and ambitious local brands. Give customers a feel for your place before they arrive.
hero.scroll: Scroll to explore, or drag a panorama
language.title: Choose your language
language.description: You can change this anytime from the top of the page.
spaces.label: Spaces for your business
space.hotel-lobby.title: Hotel lobby
space.hotel-lobby.description: Set the tone before guests arrive with a welcoming lobby, clear amenities and an easy path to booking.
space.hotel-suite.title: Hotel suite
space.hotel-suite.description: Let future guests picture their stay with a calm room tour, thoughtful details and direct availability enquiries.
space.restaurant.title: Restaurant
space.restaurant.description: Bring your dining room and signature menu to life, then make a table reservation just one tap away.
space.restaurant.alt: Elegant restaurant interior with warmly lit dining tables
space.cafe.title: Cafe
space.cafe.description: Show the atmosphere, coffee and menu that make your cafe worth a visit, with a simple way to get in touch.
space.cafe.alt: Sunlit specialty cafe with a wood coffee bar
space.gym.title: Gym & fitness
space.gym.description: Showcase your training space, classes and membership options so new members know where to begin.
space.gym.alt: Modern fitness studio with neatly arranged equipment
space.salon.title: Salon & spa
space.salon.description: Present your services, team and appointment options in a polished space that feels as considered as your studio.
space.salon.alt: Refined salon interior with mirrors and styling chairs
space.boutique.title: Boutique
space.boutique.description: Give clothing and jewellery collections room to shine with an elegant gallery and personal enquiries.
space.boutique.alt: Curated clothing and jewellery boutique interior
space.bakery.title: Bakery
space.bakery.description: Make your bakes irresistible with a warm product gallery, custom-order details and a direct enquiry button.
space.bakery.alt: Artisan bakery with a pastry display counter
space.coaching.title: Coaching class
space.coaching.description: Explain your courses, teaching approach and batches clearly, and help families enquire with confidence.
space.coaching.alt: Bright, modern coaching and learning studio
space.furniture.title: Furniture studio
space.furniture.description: Let customers explore your designs, materials and finished spaces, then ask for a tailored quote.
space.furniture.alt: Thoughtfully styled furniture and interiors showroom
space.brand-store.title: Local brand store
space.brand-store.description: Tell the story behind your products and help people discover, compare and enquire about your collection.
space.brand-store.alt: Minimal local product brand store interior
hotspot.services.copy: See how a thoughtful website can introduce your business, highlight what you offer and guide visitors to the next step.
hotspot.booking.copy: Make it easy for customers to ask a question, check availability or start a booking directly on WhatsApp.
hotspot.quote.copy: Tell us a little about your business and we’ll suggest a clear, practical website plan.
estimator.title: What might your website cost?
estimator.description: Choose your business type, pages and features. See an approximate range and delivery estimate, then send your options to us on WhatsApp.
estimator.note: This is a planning range, not a fixed quote. We’ll confirm the scope and final range together.
estimator.recipient: Choose who receives this quote on WhatsApp
estimator.pagesError: Enter a number of pages from 1 to 30.
estimator.languageError: Choose at least one website language.
estimator.quoteSavedError: The quote could not be saved on this device. Please try again.
